A proclamation posted on the customs house door.

## The Text

Be it known to all masters, crews and residents of this port:

That from this day the waters beyond the harbour mouth known as the Teeth are closed to all vessels between sunset and sunrise.

That any master found within those waters after dark shall forfeit his vessel and pay a fine of fifty marks.

That no lamp, signal or fire shall be shown from the outer mole after the evening bell.

Given under our hand and seal at the Customs House, this first day of March.
